{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Rebar → `uRebarInterleave` (also on the Comma ribbon tab, Rebar block)
{{% /callout %}}

Splits each picked rebar group into two interleaved groups without moving a bar: the group keeps bars 1, 3, 5... and a new group takes bars 2, 4, 6... The new group is created as a copy of the original (attributes, phase, hooks).

**How to use:**

1.  Select the rebar groups in Tekla, or leave the selection empty. Choose whether the new group gets the next class and click **Apply**.
2.  When nothing was selected, pick the rebar groups and finish the picks with a middle-click.
3.  The status line says how many groups were split. Groups that were not split are listed with the reason in a message. The command repeats until <kbd>Esc</kbd>; the selection is used for the first round only.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Next class for the new group** | The new group (bars 2, 4, 6...) gets the class of the original + 1, so the two sets show in different colours. |

It works from the bars you see, whatever the spacing type or the excluded bars; both groups become exact spacings. A group of fewer than four bars is left as it is, and a split that does not come out as planned is undone.

{{% callout type="warning" %}}
After a native failure partial changes can remain: inspect the reported object and use Undo.
{{% /callout %}}
